article.title: Amendment of Act 45 of 1860.
article.content:
91Amendment of Act 45 of 1860.

91. [Amendment of Act 45 of 1860.]—Omitted by the Information Technology (Amendment) Act, 2008 (10 of 2009), s. 48 (w.e.f. 27-10-2009).
Note: this section had amended the Indian Penal Code, 1860; the amendments themselves survive in that Code — only the amending section was omitted as spent.
